response.sql: SELECT language_id, AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost, AVG(length) AS avg_running_time FROM film WHERE length >= 112 AND length IS NOT NULL GROUP BY language_id ORDER BY avg_running_time DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: “Using 112 minutes as the running-time cutoff” means films with a running time of at least 112 minutes qualify.

alternatives.interpretation: If the cutoff means strictly longer than 112 minutes, exclude films that are exactly 112 minutes.
alternatives.sql: SELECT language_id, AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost, AVG(length) AS avg_running_time FROM film WHERE length > 112 GROUP BY language_id ORDER BY avg_running_time DESC LIMIT 10
